name: manual_2d0119
claim: A plan status banner like "RESOLVED" or "shipped" on a merged module means unit tests passed and code landed — not that any real dispatch path calls it. Verify real callers (grep/CRG) before trusting a shipped/resolved claim for wiring status.

decisions.notes: v1.1-definitive.md's "RESOLVED 2026-06-14 — v1.1 shipped: ... frugality ..." banner was accurate for what it claimed (module merged, tests passing) but easy to misread as "wired into production dispatch," which frugality_router.py never was. This ambiguity cost real investigation time this session before the gbrain trace clarified it.
